attempts.decision: Starting 4e-6 was supported on this smoke direction.

attempts.treatment: unshifted current equation and stabilized right inverse
attempts.expected: Stored, Arnoldi and fresh checks on a material failed nonzero direction
attempts.decision: Action gap reproduced. Fixed colored control internal solve passed and its current checks failed. No accepted update.

attempts.treatment: Same coefficients and directions across current spacing probes. Three full-row singletons against their complete colors.
attempts.expected: Check claimed support rows and locate a measured action-sensitivity range without new factors.
attempts.decision: Three selected supports consistent. 256e-6 was the smallest tested common spacing passing the declared sensitivity allowances.

attempts.expected: Fresh current errors and action sensitivity should permit original globalization
attempts.decision: Two 0.00125 updates accepted. Third direction passed both fresh linear targets and exhausted feasible Armijo trials.

attempts.treatment: Start from exact second accepted field with .00035 seeded Armijo trial and saved effective forcing .3
attempts.expected: Measure actual reduction inside the curvature-derived fraction range
attempts.decision: One smaller backtracked original update accepted. Next direction exceeded the action allowance before actual trials.

attempts.treatment: Exact 16×24 replay, independent original order 28, and final accepted-direction bracket
attempts.decision: Original residual remains above its limit under independent integration. The accepted-direction bracket informs the next bounded test.

known_limitations: The initial failed-krylov raw_first_backsolve_residual omitted the inverse shift because its prepare callback queried moved callback storage. That row and the unshifted row represent the unshifted matrix. The final native check measured both operators directly.

The terminal direction exceeded the action allowance after passing the true checks and was outside the initial linear-failure capture trigger. The final no-factor probe uses the last accepted step difference.
The selected-column comparison covers three foot columns and does not bound all colored assembly errors.
